mapper.select: SELECT cs.id AS sessionId, cs.status AS status, cs.assessment_id AS assessmentId, cs.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id) AS messageCount, (SELECT m.content FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT m.created_at FROM consult_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastAt FROM consult_session cs WHERE cs.resident_id = #{residentId} AND cs.consult_type = 'AI' ORDER BY cs.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
